text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"—This is Sei-chan.
I'm currently keeping an eye on
a suspicious duo along with Cafe-san."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...No... I just have some business
in the kitchen...
that's all...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come along with me!
Aren't you curious what those two
are making? Huh? Aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: (...It won't become...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-san, how about a tea-flavored cake?
Pound cake is relatively simple to make, after all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that's fine with me.
I'm just going to eat it myself anyway,
so it doesn't need to be anything fancy."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh... You're not giving it to them
for Valentine's Day?
I totally thought...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's? Ah, is it that time of year already?
I don't particularly plan on giving anything, but... actually,
it does make for a splendid day for an experiment.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you're offering sweets, I'd gladly accept.
Like I said before, black tea cake is just fine.
Make it extra sweet for me, will you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, ah... I'm the one making it?
Got it! I'll do my best!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...How shameless...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha. Maybe I should beg for some too~.
Ugh, I'm so hungry...
If I don't eat something sweet, I'm gonna faint...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Or something?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...There's no need...
to do something like that... is there...?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —So, who are you giving Valentine's chocolate to?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Um... hehe.
C-Can you keep this a secret?
...To tell the truth...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...What a relief... right...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...What was thaaat?
I didn't hear a thiiing.
Welp, guess I'll be heading back to my room now~.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, you're right...
Maybe... this is what youth is all about..."
